content:
# Asks Codex once a month to compare this repository with the official Node.js
# lifecycle, make any needed support-policy edits, validate them, and open a
# draft pull request. If nothing has drifted, the run makes no pull request.
# Human review is always required before merge.
name: Monthly Node.js version review

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '17 14 1 * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: monthly-node-version-review
  cancel-in-progress: false

# Proposal generation and validation never receive repository write authority.
permissions: {}

jobs:
  propose:
    if: github.repository == 'openai/openai-node' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    permissions:
      contents: read
    environment: ci
    outputs:
      artifact-id: ${{ steps.upload.outputs.artifact-id }}
    steps:
      - name: Check out the workflow commit
        uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Set up Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4
        with:
          node-version-file: '.nvmrc'

      - name: Ask Codex to review Node.js support
        id: codex
        uses: openai/codex-action@52fe01ec70a42f454c9d2ebd47598f9fd6893d56 # v1
        with:
          openai-api-key: ${{ secrets.OPENAI_API_KEY }}
          prompt-file: .github/codex/prompts/node-version-review.md
          codex-version: '0.144.6'
          codex-args: '["--config","web_search=\"live\"","--ephemeral"]'
          permission-profile: ':workspace'
          safety-strategy: drop-sudo

      - name: Export the untrusted proposal as JSON
        env:
          EXPECTED_BASE_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
          PROPOSAL_PATH: ${{ runner.temp }}/node-review-export/proposal.json
          REVIEW_BODY: ${{ steps.codex.outputs.final-message }}
        run: |
          python3 scripts/node-version-review.py export \
            --base-sha "$EXPECTED_BASE_SHA" \
            --proposal "$PROPOSAL_PATH"

      - name: Upload the original proposal
        id: upload
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: node-review-proposal-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/node-review-export/proposal.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 1

  validate:
    needs: propose
    if: github.repository == 'openai/openai-node' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Check out the workflow commit
        uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Download the original proposal
        uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c # v8.0.1
        with:
          artifact-ids: ${{ needs.propose.outputs.artifact-id }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/node-review-proposal
          merge-multiple: true
          digest-mismatch: error

      - name: Verify and apply the proposal
        id: proposal
        env:
          EXPECTED_BASE_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
          PROPOSAL_PATH: ${{ runner.temp }}/node-review-proposal/proposal.json
          BODY_PATH: ${{ runner.temp }}/node-review-body.md
        run: |
          python3 scripts/node-version-review.py apply \
            --base-sha "$EXPECTED_BASE_SHA" \
            --proposal "$PROPOSAL_PATH" \
            --body-output "$BODY_PATH"

      - name: Set up pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@f40ffcd9367d9f12939873eb1018b921a783ffaa # v4

      - name: Set up Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4
        with:
          node-version-file: '.nvmrc'
          cache: pnpm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
          ./scripts/steady/install

      - name: Check Node.js version policy
        run: node --experimental-strip-types scripts/check-node-version-policy.ts

      - name: Lint the repository
        run: ./scripts/lint

      - name: Build the repository
        run: ./scripts/build

      - name: Check published source types with TypeScript 4.9
        run: ./node_modules/typescript-4-9/bin/tsc --project dist/src/tsconfig.json --noEmit

      - name: Check published source types with TypeScript 6
        run: ./node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --project dist/src/tsconfig.json --noEmit

      - name: Check packed browser and edge consumers
        run: node --experimental-strip-types scripts/test-packed-package.ts

      - name: Check TypeScript types
        run: pnpm exec tsc

      - name: Generate package type analysis
        run: pnpm exec attw --pack dist -f json > .attw.json || true

      - name: Check package types
        run: node scripts/utils/attw-report.cjs

      - name: Check the published package
        run: pnpm exec publint dist

      - name: Run tests
        run: ./scripts/test

  publish:
    needs: [propose, validate]
    if: github.repository == 'openai/openai-node' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      - name: Check out the workflow commit
        uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false

      # create-pull-request resets the working branch to origin/main. Keep both
      # refs at the validated commit so a concurrent main update cannot rebase it.
      - name: Preserve the validated base
        env:
          EXPECTED_BASE_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
        run: |
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED_BASE_SHA"
          git checkout -B main "$EXPECTED_BASE_SHA"
          git update-ref refs/remotes/origin/main "$EXPECTED_BASE_SHA"

      - name: Download the original proposal
        uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c # v8.0.1
        with:
          artifact-ids: ${{ needs.propose.outputs.artifact-id }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/node-review-proposal
          merge-multiple: true
          digest-mismatch: error

      - name: Verify and apply the proposal
        id: proposal
        env:
          EXPECTED_BASE_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
          PROPOSAL_PATH: ${{ runner.temp }}/node-review-proposal/proposal.json
          BODY_PATH: ${{ runner.temp }}/node-review-body.md
        run: |
          python3 scripts/node-version-review.py apply \
            --base-sha "$EXPECTED_BASE_SHA" \
            --proposal "$PROPOSAL_PATH" \
            --body-output "$BODY_PATH"

      - name: Open or update the draft pull request
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@22a9089034f40e5a961c8808d113e2c98fb63676 # v7
        with:
          token: ${{ github.token }}
          base: main
          branch: codex/monthly-node-version-update
          delete-branch: true
          draft: always-true
          commit-message: 'chore(node): review supported Node.js versions'
          title: 'chore(node): review supported Node.js versions'
          body-path: ${{ runner.temp }}/node-review-body.md
          add-paths: |
            .nvmrc
            package.json
            README.md
            .github/CONTRIBUTING.md
            NODE_VERSION_POLICY.md
